video_title: Watch Out For Timberwolves AKA ‘Your Favorite Player’s Favorite Team’

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' trade for Rudy Gobert has impressed current and former players
quotes.excerpt: the Timberwolves are kind of your favorite player's favorite team
quotes.quote: A team that made a swing over the summer that I have to say, when I have worked with other former players here in ESPN, this week it's been a mon-shumper, it's been Kendrick Perkins, but just watching the reaction over the summer of what the former players or even some current players think about the Timberwolves' decision to trade for Rudy Gobert has been very interesting. And I've started to say that the Timberwolves are kind of your favorite player's favorite team because players are attracted to the way that the Timberwolves want to play. I can feel it. Players love the idea of the way LaMelo and Ant Edwards are going to play together.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch's 'moodiness for giddiness' quote about the Timberwolves' trade
quotes.quote: One of the more interesting quotes in the whole preseason came from Chris Finch when he said, we traded moodiness for giddiness. It's a fascinating quote because it's not and he didn't mean Naz Reid as the moodiness, he was talking about Julius Randle. It's a shot at Julius Randle, who was annoyed a lot last year because he was in trade rumors.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Players are excited about the Timberwolves' offensive potential
quotes.excerpt: Players love the idea of the way LaMelo and Ant Edwards are going to play together
quotes.quote: I can feel it. Players love the idea of the way LaMelo and Ant Edwards are going to play together.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' magnetic personality is a key factor for Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards is that on steroids with the way he's just captured folks' attention
quotes.quote: It's personality too. That's the main thing. Again, I mean look, we spent the first part talking about like the Yaxl personality, like Anthony Edwards is that on steroids with the way he's just captured folks' attention. You mentioned that the players love and I saw like one of the podcast clip where it was DeMarcus Cousins basically calling them his favorite team now.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Windhorst notes that some analysts are picking Minnesota for the Finals
quotes.excerpt: Shump has picked the Wolves and the Raptors to make the Finals
quotes.quote: Shump has picked the Wolves and the Raptors to make the Finals.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of playing alongside LaMelo Ball and Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: Watch how the other players on the court react and interact with playing with LaMelo and Ant
quotes.quote: One of the things that Shump has been talking about is, watch how the other players on the court react and interact with playing with LaMelo and Ant. Like, he, you know, like and a a a fascinating weather vane, is that too arcane of a reference, a fascinating, you know, like, to watch is how Rudy Gobert operates. Because you know how Gobert, you know, he'd like to have the ball in his hands a little bit, you know, as you've talked a lot about over the years, McMahon.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's love language is lobs and awards
quotes.excerpt: His love language is lobs and awards
quotes.quote: His love language is lobs and awards.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's role in the Timberwolves' transition game
quotes.excerpt: Rudy is like grabbing the ball off the rim and heaving it down the court
quotes.quote: Rudy is like grabbing the ball off the rim and heaving it down the court. He's getting rid of it because he wants to start the break. He wants to get the ball in the hands of LaMelo and Ant obviously.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The difference in popularity of LaMelo Ball between players and executives
quotes.excerpt: the popularity of LaMelo among players versus the popularity of LaMelo among like executives and scouts
quotes.quote: The popularity of LaMelo among players versus the popularity of LaMelo among like executives and scouts, I'm not going to say it's polar opposites, but it's very, very different.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards is thriving in his new role with Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards is one of the players who loves LaMelo, and he is clearly invigorated by this deal
quotes.quote: Anthony Edwards is one of the players who loves LaMelo, and he is clearly invigorated by this deal. He didn't have to pretend that he's a point guard anymore. And even, like, even his ISO stuff, it's coming after somebody else brings the ball up the floor. He doesn't have to deal with bringing the ball up the floor while he's, you know, got somebody in his face the whole time and bumping him the whole way. And so, he's more energetic. He's talked about having more, you know, saying, hey, if I don't got to bring the ball up the floor, I can pour myself back into being the type of defender that I should be. So, you know, we'll see that. And so it is a different deal for him, just being freed from the point guard responsibilities.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Bontemps admits he is a long-time LaMelo Ball skeptic
quotes.excerpt: I'm a long-time LaMelo skeptic, but Anthony Edwards is not
quotes.quote: I'm a long-time LaMelo skeptic, but Anthony Edwards is not, and his opinion does matter more than mine on this matter.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The priority of player happiness in Minnesota and Los Angeles
quotes.excerpt: LaMelo's happiness was the absolute top priority in Minnesota this year
quotes.quote: LaMelo's happiness was the absolute top priority in Minnesota this year for good reason, just like Luka's happiness was the absolute top priority in LA the summer for good reason. And they got Ant the point guard that he really wanted in Minnesota, they got Luka the big man he really wanted in LA. They are both pretty limited as far as what else they can do to upgrade, but their stars are happy and their stars came out and, you know, step one of 82 was pretty damn impressive by both of them.
